blocks.html: Where testing is required, lateral load tests shall be performed in accordance with ASTM D 3966. A minimum of two deep foundations shall be tested for every area of similar subsurface conditions. For conditions where multiple types or capacities of deep foundations are used, refer to Section 1810.2.5.
